channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Saladworks: $6.99 Build Your Own Bowl on Mondays (Acai, Pitaya, Oatmeal or Yogurt Base)
item.guid: Saladworks-$6.99 Build Your Own Bowl on Mondays (Ac-2026-11-16
item.description: Mondays only at 14 Saladworks stores that also serve Frutta Bowls, including Fairfax (9414 Fairfax Blvd), Virginia Beach, Chesterfield and Newport News: build your own 16 oz bowl for $6.99 with a base, granola, fruit and a topping. The regular build-your-own bowl is $9.99 for a mini and $11.99 for a regular. Order at the counter or pick the "6.99 BYO Bowl" category on that store's Saladworks ordering page, where it appears on Mondays; no code or account needed. If your store's page does not show the category on a Monday, it is not taking part. (Some stores only: VA, NJ, PA, DE, FL, NC, TN, TX only) (Mondays only)

item.title: Top Pick: Luna Grill: Medi Mondays: $5 Off a Build Your Own Bowl or $10 Off a Family Meal for Club Luna Members
item.guid: Luna Grill-Medi Mondays: $5 Off a Build Your Own Bo-2026-11-16
item.description: Every Monday, Club Luna Rewards members (free account) pick one in the Luna Grill app: $5 off a Build Your Own Bowl (app-only item) or $10 off a Family Meal. One offer per transaction; not combinable with the rewards balance. Stated on Luna Grill's own Club Luna rewards page. (SoCal & Texas only) (Mondays only)

item.title: Pancheros Mexican Grill: $5 Off a $10+ Order with Code THANK5 in the Pancheros App
item.guid: Pancheros Mexican Grill-$5 Off a $10+ Order with Code THANK5 in -2026-11-16
item.description: All November: enter code THANK5 in the Pancheros app (free account) for $5 off any order of $10 or more, which covers a burrito or bowl plus a side or drink. The homepage states no exclusions; one code per order. Stated on Pancheros' own homepage. (12 states (IA, NJ, MN, MO & Midwest) only) (Through November 30, 2026)

item.title: Blowfish Poke: $9 Regular Poke Bowl on Mondays
item.guid: Blowfish Poke-$9 Regular Poke Bowl on Mondays-2026-11-16
item.description: Every Monday at the Clarksville and Marriottsville, Maryland locations: a regular-size poke bowl is $9 instead of the usual $14. No code or account needed. The Annapolis and Washington, DC locations are not included. Stated under Weekly Specials on Blowfish Poke's own homepage. (Maryland only (Clarksville & Marriottsville) only) (Mondays only)

item.title: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill: Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Appetizers with Code BOGO, Online Orders
item.guid: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill-Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Ap-2026-11-16
item.description: Limited time at Michigan locations: add two qualifying items from the same category on the chain's own ordering site (for example a Chicken Great Greek Gyro, Feta-Filled Kebab Gyro or Falafel Pita, $10.99 to $12.99 each) and enter promo code BOGO at checkout to get one free. One BOGO per order; categories cannot be mixed; no account needed. Seen on the Byron Center, Ann Arbor, West Bloomfield, Troy and Allen Park ordering pages. (Michigan only only) (Limited time)

item.title: Pita Way: Kids Eat Free with Every Adult Entree, Dine-In
item.guid: Pita Way-Kids Eat Free with Every Adult Entree, D-2026-11-16
item.description: Every day, dine-in only: kids 12 and under get a free mini rice bowl with each adult entree (a Premium Bowl, Sandweech or Large Salad), up to two kids per adult entree. Children must be there when you order; not valid online or through delivery apps. A kids bowl is usually $6.49. Stated on Pita Way's own specials page. (MI, OH, TN & IN only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Pita Way: Monday Special: Legacy Bowl and a Drink for $9.99, Online Orders
item.guid: Pita Way-Monday Special: Legacy Bowl and a Drink -2026-11-16

The bowl alone is usually $12.99. No code or account needed; cannot be combined with other discounts. Stated on Pita Way's own specials page. (MI, OH, TN & IN only) (Mondays only)

item.title: Roots Natural Kitchen: Kids Eat Free with the Purchase of an Adult Bowl
item.guid: Roots Natural Kitchen-Kids Eat Free with the Purchase of an Ad-2026-11-16
item.description: Every day at Roots Natural Kitchen: a child under 12 eats free with each adult grain or salad bowl purchased. The child has to be there with you; no code or account needed. Roots states no day or time limits, so confirm at the counter when you order. Shown on every page of Roots' own site, including the Fairfax, Virginia location page. (VA, PA, OH, NC, DE & WV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Cowboy Chicken: Kids Eat Free on Mondays After 4 PM with an Adult Entree

item.title: Freebirds World Burrito: $10 Monster Mondays: Any Monster Burrito or Bowl for $10
item.guid: Freebirds World Burrito-$10 Monster Mondays: Any Monster Burrito-2026-11-16

Extras cost more; not combinable with other offers and not available through third-party delivery; no account needed. Stated on Freebirds' own homepage. (Texas only only) (Mondays only)

item.title: Corner Bakery Cafe: Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Half Salad, Soup, Sandwich or Pasta Plus a Side
item.guid: Corner Bakery Cafe-Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Hal-2026-11-16
item.description: Limited time at select cafes: any Choose Two combo (two of a half salad, half soup, half sandwich or half pasta) plus a side for $8.99, all day. Enter code 1551 at online checkout or mention it in the cafe; no account needed, not valid on third-party delivery. The offer is set cafe by cafe: it shows for Fair Oaks in Fairfax, Bethesda, both DC cafes and cafes in Illinois, Texas, Georgia, Pennsylvania and Tennessee, so pick your cafe on Corner Bakery's offers page to confirm before you go. (Select cafes: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX, GA, PA & TN only) (Limited time)

item.title: Luna Grill: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
item.guid: Luna Grill-Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal -2026-11-16
